description: Prewind-style utility classes over the Nowind theme, with Tailwind v4 names where they overlap. One plain stylesheet, no build step for consumers: every class already exists. Regenerate after changing theme tokens, then rebuild the bundle.

setup.order: @layer reset, styles, nowind; (declared at the top of nowind.css)
setup.bundle: node scripts/bundle.mjs writes dist/nowind.bundle.css and dist/nowind.min.css: theme.css with every @import inlined, then this file. Run it after this script.
setup.rule: Put your own global CSS in @layer styles. Unlayered CSS beats every utility.

naming: property-value, as Prewind and Tailwind: p-md, gap-lg, bg-solid-accent-1. Colour classes take the token name without --; text-color roles are the token name alone (fg-weak, fg-accent-1).

variants.hover: Inside @media (hover: hover), as Tailwind v4, so taps on touch screens don't stick. hover:border-* for the border roles, hover:fg-* and hover:bg-* for the colour role tokens only (bg, component, border, solid, on-solid, fg and their palette versions), hover:opacity-*, hover:cursor-*. Raw steps of neutral, accent-1 to accent-4 and danger take hover too (hover:bg-neutral-4), so examples can use primitives only; alpha steps and the status palettes' steps have no hover class.
variants.responsive: sm:, md:, lg:, xl:, 2xl: (read from the --breakpoint-* tokens) apply to layout: display, grid columns and spans, flex direction, wrap, basis, justify, align, text alignment, widths, heights, position, top, overflow, padding and gaps. Margins, colours and type have no breakpoint variants.
variants.groups: group on a parent; group-hover:, group-focus-within: and group-open: on a child, for opacity, visibility and text roles (tooltips, reveal-on-hover).
variants.states: active:, focus-visible:, focus-within: (a field wrapper whose input has focus), selected: (aria-selected="true"), aria-current:, aria-pressed:, aria-expanded:, open: (details, popovers), aria-invalid: (also :user-invalid), has-invalid: (a wrapper holding an invalid input) and disabled: (also aria-disabled). Colors only (plus opacity and cursor for disabled), for the neutral and accent roles; aria-invalid for neutral and danger.
variants.none: No group- or dark: variants. Dark mode comes from the theme's light-dark() tokens.

categories.spacing: p-, px-, py-, pt-, pr-, pb-, pl-, m-*, -m-*, m*-auto, gap-, gap-x-, gap-y- with 0 and 3xs, 2xs, xs, sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl, 3xl, 4xl; scroll-mt-* (where a linked element stops under sticky bars) with the same steps, no 0
categories.typeScale: text-{xs, sm, base, lg, xl, 2xl, 3xl, 4xl, 5xl, 6xl} (sets size and line height)
categories.kicker: text-{kicker-sm, kicker-md, kicker-lg} (size and the kicker style)
categories.typeRoles: text-{display-lg, display-md, display-sm, display, heading-xl, heading-lg, heading-md, heading-sm, figure, lead, quote, title, subtitle, body-lg, body-md, body-sm, caption, footnote, title-sm, control-md, data, label, kicker, numeral, mono, mono-sm, code, kbd} (every role companion)
categories.colors: A colour class is the property prefix plus the token name, minus the role group when it matches the prefix (fg-weak, bg-accent-1, border-weak; bg-component-accent-1 keeps its group). --border is border-default, because border is the width class; the reset draws every border in --border. Each property takes only its own roles: fg- with fg-* and on-solid-*; bg- with bg-*, component-*, solid-*, surface, indicator and track; border- with border-*. Raw palette steps (fg-accent-1-9, bg-accent-1-9, border-accent-1-9) work with all three; alpha steps (neutral-a4) with bg- only. No outline colour classes: the reset sets the focus ring.
categories.radius: rounded-none, rounded-xs (nested), rounded-sm and rounded (control), rounded-lg (surface), rounded-xl (dialog), rounded-full. Tailwind v4 names.
categories.shadows: shadow-xs, shadow-sm (and bare shadow), shadow-md, shadow-lg, shadow-xl, shadow-none; inset-shadow-xs, inset-shadow-sm, inset-shadow-none. Compound shadows after Massimo (theme.shadows.css); a cast and a recess on one element compose, as in Tailwind v4.
categories.borders: border, border-0, -2, -4, with sides t r b l x y; border-solid/dashed/dotted/none
categories.layout: container, display, grid-cols-1…12, col-span-1…12 and -full, flex, basis fractions, position, inset, z-
categories.controls: h-control, h-nested (an .icon inside it shrinks by the two borders so it fits), size-control, size-nested, min-w-control, min-w-nested, px-control and px-nested (padding steps in by one margin on a side whose first or last child is .icon; wrap the label in a <span>), gap-gutter, gap-gutter-half
categories.levels: p-surface, p-dialog (each minus the border), p-region, p-page, with px- and py- versions; gap-field, gap-row, gap-group, gap-section, gap-page; mt-section, mb-section. After Affine's container levels.
categories.materials: material-flat, -physical, -frosted, -glass, -outline set a region's material (nearest wins, by @scope); relief-raised, -raised-solid, -recessed, -field, -etched, -ground, -overlay say what a part is. After Massimo.
categories.grid: gap-grid, gap-x-grid (2M), p-grid-inset (M), px-grid (slot), px-grid-compact; shell: w-sidebar (16F + 16), w-rail, h-header, min-h-header, top-header (a sticky offset under the header), scroll-pt-header (on <html>, so in-page links land below a sticky header), h-below-header, max-h-below-header, max-w-measure (44F). After Affine.
categories.tiers: tier-product (1×), tier-content (font +2px, spacing 1.5×), tier-brand (font +4px, spacing 2×). Each is a scope: --F and everything derived recompute inside it.
categories.animation: animate-spin, animate-pulse, animate-none (cut by the reset under reduced motion).
categories.anchor: anchor-bottom, -top, -start, -end, -center: place a popover against its invoker with CSS anchor positioning, flipping at the screen edge.
categories.select: select-base: the customizable select (appearance: base-select), its picker and options in the theme. The value is centred in the field; the highlighted option shows by its background, not a focus ring.
categories.motion: transition, transition-colors, -opacity, -shadow, -transform, -none (state-change length and easing by default); duration-fade, -snappy, -smooth, -bouncy; ease-smooth, -snappy, -bouncy (Massimo springs as linear()), ease-standard, -out, -in.
categories.marks: The reset draws checkboxes, radios, switches (<input type=checkbox role=switch>) and sliders at Affine's mark size (between F and the slot), filled with accent-1 when checked; mark-sm and mark-lg pick another size.
categories.icons: icon (an S-square box, glyph --icon-md), icon-sm, icon-md, icon-lg. Glyphs: Phosphor web font (<i class="icon ph ph-floppy-disk">; ph-bold at sm, ph-light at lg) or an inline <svg> inside .icon.
categories.sizing: w-, h-, min-/max- with 0, full, screen (100vw/100vh), fit; w-1/2, 1/3, 2/3, 1/4, 3/4 and fifths; h-dvh, h-svh, h-lvh and min-/max- versions; max-w-text (alias max-w-prose), max-w-form, max-w-container, h-control

changesFromPrewind: container: width min(100%, --container-max), so it never overflows a narrow screen (Prewind's 360px minimum did).
No bg-opacity-*: it relied on relative colour syntax with no fallback and was inherited by children. Use the alpha steps (bg-accent-1-a3, bg-neutral-a5) instead.
No m-full / p-full: margin and padding percentages are of the width, not a full size.
Margins and padding x/y use logical properties (margin-inline, padding-block).
text-{size} also sets the matching line height, as Tailwind v4.

The reset keeps link underlines and adds a 2026 baseline: :where() selectors (no specificity), interpolate-size, text-size-adjust, font-synthesis none, headings set from the type roles (h1 heading-xl … h6 title-sm), text-wrap balance/pretty, field-sizing content, accent and caret colours, :focus-visible ring, :target scroll margin, [hidden] enforced, role=list, tabular table figures, ::backdrop and ::selection from tokens, and reduced-motion handling, and a forced-colors (Windows High Contrast) block: controls and overlays keep an outline, selected, pressed and current items a Highlight outline, and checkboxes, radios, switches and sliders are redrawn in system colors. Focus: buttons, links and checkable controls get a 2px accent ring on :focus-visible; text fields (text-like inputs, textarea, select) get no ring and turn their border accent instead, with a Highlight outline in forced colours. Native controls without a base appearance are themed in the reset: the file input's button looks like a secondary button, progress is an accent bar on a component track, and meter turns success, warning or danger from its low, high and optimum attributes; each gets system colours in forced colours. field-sizing-content and field-sizing-fixed size a field to its content or not (textareas grow by default). Controls share one recipe in utilities, enforced by scripts/check.mjs: h-control (or size-control), px-control, a border width (border-transparent on solid fills, never border-0), rounded-control and a control type role. caret, on an icon box (icon caret), is the one disclosure chevron; select-base draws the same chevron as its picker icon, and both turn over when open. bg-dots paints a dot grid in currentColor (set the colour with fg-*), spaced by bg-dots-sm, -md or -lg. lens refracts the backdrop through an SVG displacement filter (id nowind-lens, a bend along the rim with an R/G/B fringe) when the page sets data-lens="on" on the root; only Chromium applies an SVG filter in backdrop-filter, so the page sets it after checking the engine, and without it the material's own blur applies.

No outline-{colour} classes, no text-/border- classes for alpha steps, and no class that pairs a role with another property (no bg-fg-*, text-bg-*, bg-border-*). Text-color roles are named by their token alone: fg, fg-weak, fg-accent-1-weak.
Tailwind v4 names where v4 renamed v3 ones: rounded-xs/sm, shadow-xs/sm, backdrop-blur-xs/sm; h-screen is 100vh with h-dvh/svh/lvh separate; a 2xl breakpoint; aliases max-w-prose and font-sans.
Added: grid display, text-start/end, justify-evenly, items-baseline, tabular-nums, text-balance/pretty, w-fit, h-control, kicker and type-role classes.
